notes: A newly installed update now confirms itself the moment the app script is up, instead of 4 seconds after the page finished loading — on a slow phone the old timing made a perfectly good update look like one that never started, so it was rolled back and then offered again on every launch (install, reload, roll back, install…)
An update that fails to take over is marked as bad on your device and never auto-installed again. The app stays on the version that works and tells you once, instead of you being stuck refreshing
Fixed the library snapshot restore re-running its reload on every launch after an update — it is now a one-shot repair, so it cannot loop
Restores the album and RGB fixes from 58.6, which were rolled back before they could stick
